summary.text: Matt Pierce is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 61, which he has represented since 2002, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate in the general election for the seat.

paragraphs.text: Matt Pierce earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana University in 1984 and a law degree from the Indiana University School of Law in 1987.

His professional experience includes working as a visiting lecturer in the Indiana University Department of Telecommunications, as chief of staff to Congressman Baron Hill, as principal clerk of the Indiana House, and on the House staff.
Pierce served on the Bloomington City Council from 1995 to 2002 before joining the Indiana House in 2002.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the Courts and Criminal Code, Rules and Legislative Procedures, Statutory Committee on Ethics, and Utilities, Energy and Telecommunications committees.
Ballotpedia notes that Pierce was among 37 House Democrats who took part in a walkout on February 22, 2011, in opposition to proposed right-to-work legislation.
